description: Avoid setting state synchronously in the body of a useEffect, useLayoutEffect or useInsertionEffect callback; derive the value during render or set it from a subscription callback.

violation.message: Don't set state synchronously in this effect: derive the value during render, or set it from a callback the effect subscribes; a setState here re-renders right after every commit.
Don't pass a function that sets state synchronously as this effect: derive the value during render, or set it from a callback the effect subscribes.
